summary.zh: 让盐酸与碳酸氢钠反应持续放出二氧化碳，连接导管把气体导入倒置的集气瓶，对比“接导管”与“不接导管”的结局。
summary.en: React hydrochloric acid with sodium bicarbonate for a sustained CO₂ stream, pipe it into an inverted collection cylinder, and compare outcomes with and without the tubing.

model_scope.zh: 仅限酸-碳酸氢钠限定体系；二氧化碳按不溶于水、不参与碳酸平衡处理；收集速率是教学近似。
model_scope.en: Limited to the acid–bicarbonate system; CO₂ is treated as insoluble with no carbonate equilibria; collection rate is a teaching approximation.

description.zh: 强酸，与碳酸氢钠 1:1 放出二氧化碳。
description.en: Strong acid; releases CO₂ 1:1 with bicarbonate.

objective.zh: 用导管把发生瓶和倒置的集气瓶连接起来。
objective.en: Connect the generator to the inverted cylinder with the delivery tube.

hint_ladder.zh: 连接操作：选导管，起点是发生瓶，终点是集气瓶。
hint_ladder.en: Connect: pick the tube, source is the generator, target the cylinder.

objective.zh: 量取约 15 mL 盐酸加入发生瓶，观察持续冒泡。
objective.en: Add about 15 mL of hydrochloric acid to the generator and watch the sustained bubbling.

hint_ladder.zh: 用移液管从盐酸瓶取 15 mL。
hint_ladder.en: Pipette 15 mL from the acid bottle.

hint_ladder.zh: 气泡来自二氧化碳；反应会持续到一方耗尽。
hint_ladder.en: Bubbles are CO₂; the reaction runs until a reactant is exhausted.

objective.zh: 等待反应继续，观察气体经导管在集气瓶中不断累积。
objective.en: Let the reaction continue and watch gas accumulate in the cylinder via the tube.

hint_ladder.zh: 用“等待”观察集气瓶内的气体越来越多。
hint_ladder.en: Use “wait” and watch the gas build up in the cylinder.

hint_ladder.zh: 搅拌发生瓶可以让反应跟得上。
hint_ladder.en: Stirring the generator keeps the reaction going.

question.zh: 如果不连接导管就加入盐酸，生成的二氧化碳会怎样？
question.en: If the acid is added without connecting the tubing, the CO₂ will…

label.zh: 直接逸散到空气中，收集不到
label.en: Escape to the air and be uncollectable
Enter the cylinder on its own

label.zh: 溶解回液体里不再出来
label.en: Dissolve back and stay in solution

notes.zh: 虚拟酸液按刺激性液体对待；气体无毒，但请勿让液体倒吸入导管。
notes.en: Treat the virtual acid as an irritant; the gas is harmless, but avoid suck-back into the tube.
